prompt: Vertical 9:16 macro photograph of a handmade stop-motion set: plasticine with visible thumbprints, felt and card props, a tiny desk lamp pooling warm light. A plasticine studio engineer at a cluttered miniature mixing desk of clay knobs and mugs tilts their head up to stare at camera, deadpan, patient. Behind, a cramped wall of tiny cassette boxes with blank paper labels. The balaclava has no eye, nose or mouth holes, so no skin shows anywhere; a large white ring is stitched round the whole face, and one small red triangle with rounded corners, pointing down, sits high inside the ring on the right-hand side of the picture. Gloves on both hands; no robot parts. No readable text, no logos. Thanks.
